now-sdk exec [script]

Execute a script on the instance

Parameters:
  script  Script to run on the instance. Omit to read from --file or piped stdin
                                                                        [string]

Options:
  -d, --debug                Print debug output       [boolean] [default: false]
  -f, --file                 Path to a file containing the script to run[string]
      --scope                Scope to run the script in: an application sys_id,
                             a scope name, or 'global'. Defaults to scopeId from
                             now.config.json when run inside a Fluent project
                                                                        [string]
      --reason               Why the script is being run, recorded with it on
                             the script's Script Execution History record
                                                                        [string]
      --record-for-rollback  Create a rollback context, so the script's record
                             changes can be reverted from its Script Execution
                             History record            [boolean] [default: true]
      --timeout              How long to wait for the script's response, in
                             milliseconds. Giving up does not cancel the script
                             - it keeps running on the instance
                                                      [number] [default: 300000]
      --server-logs          Print the instance's session log for the run,
                             including stack traces   [boolean] [default: false]
  -a, --auth                 Credential alias to use for authentication with
                             instance                                   [string]
  -o, --output               Output format: json for a machine-readable
                             envelope, raw to unquote the --select result
                                               [string] [choices: "json", "raw"]
  -s, --select               Dot/bracket path to extract from the output (e.g.
                             "output[0]"). Implies machine-readable output; pair
                             with --output raw for direct use in shell command
                             substitution.                              [string]
  -h, --help                 Show help                                 [boolean]
  -v, --version              Show version number                       [boolean]

Examples:
  now-sdk exec "gs.info(gs.getProperty('gl  Run an inline script
  ide.buildname'))"
  now-sdk exec --file                       Run a script from a file
  ./scripts/backfill.js
  cat script.js | now-sdk exec              Run a script from stdin
  now-sdk exec --reason "backfill missing   Record why the script was run
  priority values" --file
  ./scripts/backfill.js
  now-sdk exec --server-logs --file         Include the instance's session log
  ./scripts/backfill.js
